source: Make a Roblox game discovery experience in 3d like ready player one

image_prompt.text: A hero structure at the centre of the hub, framed from the arrival point
An open plaza sized for a crowd to gather in between portals
Clearly identifiable portals ringing the plaza, each one leading to a different game

layout_placement.text: Portal markers at the logical endpoints of the hub, each linking out to a separate experience

notes: Preset caveat from the genre file: portals are tagged P4 because the pipeline treats them as zone transitions. If these portals lead to genuinely separate Roblox places rather than zones of this build, the hub is a single-zone P0 layout with teleport markers. Worth confirming.
The discovery half of the request - what games are surfaced and how they are chosen - is not a layout concern.

open_questions.ask: Do the portals go to real separate Roblox places, or to zones inside this same build? It changes the build cost.
How many games should the hub show at once?
Is this one plaza, or a district you walk across between areas?

theme: Sci-Fi / Cyberpunk - a neon virtual-world plaza in the register of the OASIS

coverage_missing.ask: Do the portals lead to separate places or to zones in this build?
How many games are on show, and are they grouped by genre?
One plaza or a walkable district?
Ready Player One covers a lot of looks - the neon OASIS plaza, or the junk-stacks?

answers.ask: Do the portals go to real separate Roblox places, or to zones inside this same build? It changes the build cost.
answers.answer: Use zones inside this same build, entered through portals, to keep the experience cohesive and playable as a single discovery world.

answers.ask: How many games should the hub show at once?
answers.answer: Show 6 games at once, with clear portal destinations around the hub.

answers.ask: Is this one plaza, or a district you walk across between areas?
answers.answer: Make it one compact futuristic plaza hub rather than a larger walkable district.
